applied.problem: Extrapolation is defined only as reading past the last test, but it means reading beyond the data at either end, before the first test too, as when a line is carried back toward (0, 0), which the next lesson needs.
The rule of thumb treats only readings past the last test as guesses; a reading carried on before the first test is a guess too, so the rule is narrower than the extrapolation it teaches.

notes.problem: Every number (the five tests, the readings, the 25 and 30 m³/h guesses) is an example value chosen for the lesson, as ignores says, so its kind is "assumed" (or "computed" from the curve rule), not "constant".
